text: The one breaking change this week is #14002: External File Storage now rejects any path with a whole segment of "." or "..", for all operations and connectors, so callers passing relative segments get an error. Other behaviour changes follow. #14203 makes Business Central online always use commercial Dataverse endpoints, while on-premises still respects the selected cloud. #14059 moves No. Series Copilot to the GPT-5.6 Ceres deployment. #14007 discontinues Create Product Information with Copilot, with objects obsolete pending in 30.0 and field removal in 33.0. #13558 makes the Fabric Mirroring app export its two log tables. #13587 updates corporate card manual selection in the Expense Agent. Fixes in documents and tax: #14078 corrects TaxPointDate placement in the PEPPOL30 credit memo, #14018 carries custom ship-to addresses into ZUGFeRD delivery addresses, #13987 fixes VAT number validation on sales orders, #13868 fixes Czech VAT Statement signs, #13807 fixes the German VAT Report field type, and #13243 fixes GST entries for partly received import purchase orders. Smaller fixes: #14122, #14006, #13717 and #13601. Non-behavioural work: #14143, #14081, #13965, #14118, and #9326, which moves Finland's Depreciation Differences into a first-party extension.

issues: #14122, #14006, #13717 and #13601 are listed only by number under 'Smaller fixes', so readers can't tell what changed. It would help to name them briefly (subcontracting transfer lines refresh, GP item transaction duplicates in migration, electronic payments export clearing another vendor's Document No., Customer Statistics FactBox).
#14018 is a backport to 29.x and also changes the XRechnung and PEPPOL30 exports. The paragraph mentions only ZUGFeRD, which isn't wrong but is incomplete.
#13243 applies to Import and SEZ vendors. 'Import purchase orders' is a slight simplification.
